title: qgp install recipe
description: How qgp installs one QuestPorts game. Holds only what the QuestPorts payload lacks. See docs/architecture/install-recipes.md. Uses the OpenAPI discriminator keyword, which Ajv supports with its discriminator option.

support.description: automatic: qgp does every step on the PC; the user may still act in the headset. guided: the user must also run a PC tool or do a step qgp cannot. manual: qgp can only install what it can and show the instructions.

checkedAgainst.description: Payload values the recipe was written against. build-catalog reports when the payload changes them.

version.description: port.latest_version; null when the payload has none.

targetPath.description: install.targetPath, if the payload has one.

packageName.description: Overrides install.packageName when the payload is wrong.

freeSpaceMB.description: Free space needed on the headset, in MB.

apks.description: Where the APKs come from. The first one is the game's main app.

otherWays.description: Ways to install the game that qgp does not run, such as the port's own installer or build kit. The game dialog shows each with its link.

label.description: The tool's name, shown as the link.

url.description: Where to get it: usually the release page.

help.description: What it does, and which file to download when the page has several.

notes.description: For maintainers. Not shown to users.

headsetPath.description: An absolute path under /sdcard/ that cannot leave it: no empty, . or .. segment, no backslash and no control character. Ends in / for a folder.

relativePath.description: A path relative to a folder that cannot leave it: not absolute, no drive, no .. segment and no control character.

apkGithub.description: The newest release of a GitHub repository whose tag matches `tag` and that has an asset matching `asset`; then that asset.

tag.description: Only releases whose tag matches. Default: any tag.

inZip.description: The download is a zip; the APK is the entry whose path matches this.

apkManual.description: The user downloads the APK from a page and picks the file.

asset.description: Matches the file name the user picks.

inputHelp.description: Shown to the user: what to supply and where to find it.

inputGroup.description: Inputs with the same group are alternatives: at least one of them is needed. Each is optional (required: false) on its own.

inputFree.description: Anyone can get these files at no cost, legally: a free release, a free store copy or the port's own download. qgp then counts the game as self-contained.

preparedWith.description: A tool the user runs on the PC to make this input. qgp links to it; it does not run it.

inputPcInstall.description: A game installed on the PC. qgp looks for it in each store, or the user picks the folder.

appId.description: Steam app ID or GOG product ID.

root.description: Folder inside the install that push paths and detect paths are relative to. If the user picks this folder itself, qgp uses it as is.

detect.description: Files, relative to root, that must exist for the folder to count as the right one.

inputFile.description: One or more files the user picks.

names.description: Exact file names, all required. Matched without regard to case.

extensions.description: Accepted extensions, with the dot, for one file of any name (or several, with multiple).

multiple.description: With extensions: the user picks one or more files, such as a .cue with its .bin files.

keepArchived.description: Zip files are pushed as they are, never unpacked.

disc.description: Disc header check, for formats whose header qgp can read.

platform.description: Platforms whose disc header qgp can read.

sha1.description: Accepted SHA-1 hashes, with a label for each.

checkedByApp.description: The game checks the file itself after the push.

stepShell.description: Run one command on the headset with `adb shell`, for example chmod, content call, am force-stop or touch.

args.description: The command and its arguments, one per item.

stepInstallApk.description: Install every APK in apks with `adb install -r`.

stepGrant.description: Grant a permission over adb, with `appops set` or `pm grant`.

stepLaunch.description: Start the main app, wait, and by default stop it again.

stop.description: Force-stop the app afterwards. Default: true.

stepPush.description: Push files of one input. A `to` ending in / is a folder; otherwise it is the file's new path.

from.description: A glob relative to the input's root, or a name from the input's names. A glob drops the folders before its first wildcard and keeps the rest of each path. Omitted: every file of the input.

stepVerify.description: Check over adb that files exist on the headset.

stepTell.description: Show the user something to do in the headset.
